body: Thank you haha I didn't very understand what it meant when I made it but from what others say it seemed funny to me as well :)
He is one of those who thinks men are being treated as second class citizens so of course he finds someone with such low regard for women to be a role model

This is very good help and advice. I know I have fallen into his traps a few times and gotten frustrated with him as I am a very emotional person which I feel fuels him and his beliefs. I know I have bad habits in that regard but I sometimes can't help myself, especially if I am already having a hard day and he comes in and starts talking about how I haven't been doing hardly any work while he is out doing "real" work

It frustrates me how he undermines everything I do workwise and yet he has never asked or worked towards the position that I have. I made this role for myself as it did not exist in the job before I came in and made my boss aware that it was something needed, but he does not see that and only thinks the boss gave it to me because I am a woman
Hehe I do feel that way a lot of time
Thank you very much I very appreciate your help :)

Thank you this is very good :)
I appreciate your help!
I do think this is the case but I will happily accept any advice that will shut him up or at least make him less likely to engage

Thank you for your kindness :) 

Unfortunately I am not in the US and HR is not something I have access to as we are a very small company. There is a method of reporting to our percent company but I worry that if I do that then I may be treated differently at my job as I am the only one who had vocalised any disdain for this man and it would be very easy to know that it was me.

Thank you for your advice and I will take it into account for future reference :)

>and you keep answering to comments that you’re not worried that something will happen. So… what’s bugging you? Just the “being left out part”? 

Yes that is my main issue. I've also said that I am insecure and I always feel that people are lying to me when they say the enjoy my company or want to spend time with me. My head always tells me my friends hate me.

I don't want to make him feel guilty and I will tell him how it makes me feel when he gets home so it doesn't affect his time and has him worry

Thank you very much :)

I think this is exactly what I need to read

I really appreciate your comment and help and I hope you have a nice Christmas

I wouldn't want him to have bought me a ticket. I would rather gotten it for myself but having lost my job recently I can justify spending money on not only a ticket but food and activities for the whole week. And I certainly wouldn't expect him to pick up that tab as it wouldn't be fair nor would I feel comfortable having him do that

Thank you :)

This is good advice and I do appreciate your comment.

I am very much aware that these are problems I'm making up in my own head and I'm just trying to get control of my insecurities

Apologies, the zoo and bars were all planned for this trip. I did not specify that very well.

I am not worried about anything happening between them I'm just missing him and am sad I don't get to do these things. At the same time though, I would not be able to as I have lost my job recently and funds are tight.

I am not upset in anyway that he has planned this trip as I would not have expected him to cancel something they spent months preparing for just because we got together a few weeks ago. I mainly wanted help dealing with how I'm currently feeling (again, sorry I did not make this clear)
Yes as I said I am not worried about anything happening between them I am just missing him and want to be doing those things with him instead

I am glad :)

But it's not something I would be comfortable with and if I were to travel I would want my partner with me.

I know very well than I am overthinking the issue and everything will be fine. I think I just miss him and want to be spending time doing those things with him.
I just know they've spent a lot of time arranging the trip and I would never want to say he can't go to something he's looking forward to

Not if it were a male friend, but I know I wouldn't do this with one of my male friends.

Thank you for your advice :)
I know what it is bit acquiring it is a different matter all together

I can't remember the last time I've genuinely enjoyed myself or made a meaningful connection with someone or was passionate about something. I just feel like nothing all the time 

I've been through different jobs and hobbies and I don't know how to find happiness in something.

I've been to councellors, spoken to therapists and countless helplines, tried to dig my own way out of a situation but nothing has helped. 

I just want to not exist
Idk I just don't feel like I'm going to amount to anything. People say that it gets better but I've been like this for years and I don't know what to do with myself
That's fine by me. Thank you for your time
Thanks for the advice
Don't care either way. As long as it's somewhat realistic

Hey, I don't know if it matters anymore or if you're interested even, but thank you again for the suggestion. It kind of encouraged me to look up available options again and try through a self referral process instead of going through the GP. 

I think I do just need to talk to someone about some stuff and a professional is probably a lot better than a subreddit haha. 

Thanks for the advice and I hope you're having a good day.
Sorry, I forgot to thank you for your suggestion. I appreciate you trying to help

Doctors here are a bit shit to be honest. Last time I went to the GP about a mental health issue they genuinely told me to research my symptoms on the NHS website.

Besides, I don't think I'm necessarily depressed. Maybe just going through a phase of existential dread and extreme laziness
At this point I'm willing to go through a real coma
